notes.title: Dream Runner Demo Now Live!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey y'all! The Dream Runner demo has officially launched and is available to play NOW![/b] ːsteamhappyː[/h3][p]
The demo is a curated preview of what’s to come in the final game, with a [b]Tutorial[/b] [b]level[/b] to learn your 4 abilities, a [b]Story Mode Demo[/b] [b]level[/b], and [b]5 Arcade Mode levels[/b] to run through and test your skills! Keen-eye players will also discover [b]butterflies[/b] hiding all over the demo as well - catch them and they'll join you! There are 16 total hiding around, see if you can find them all (There might be a Steam achievement in it for you...) 

We’re also announcing a [b]Virtual Speedrun Competition[/b] during [i]Steam Next Fest[/i] this week for the 5 Arcade levels included. Players who achieve the fastest completion times across the 5 Arcade Mode levels will earn a [i][b]free Steam key[/b][/i] for the complete game when it launches!

For competition details, community discussions, and updates, join our Discord community: [url="https://discord.gg/FqKa4eqEun"]https://discord.gg/FqKa4eqEun[/url]

We’ll be monitoring the demo for any bugs/issues people encounter and will be posting updates throughout the week. Have fun, hope y’all enjoy playing it as much as we enjoyed making it!
